entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_02
entries.text: You have no room for another Pokémon.\nDo you still want to try to get a gift?

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_03
entries.text:
Attention!
If your battery runs out or you’re disconnected
while you’re receiving a gift with a code or
password, you may no longer be able to receive
the gift using the same code or password.
Please check your system’s battery.
Please also make sure you have a stable
internet connection.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_04
entries.text:
Attention!
You failed to enter the correct code or password
multiple times, so you can’t try reentering
the code for a while.
Please try again later.

entries.text: Do you want to try entering the code or\npassword again?

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_08
entries.text: Something has gone wrong.\nWe aren’t able to retrieve that gift right now.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_11
entries.text: Please choose the gift you want to receive.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_12
entries.text: Do you want to stop for now?

entries.text: You can’t get that gift, since you’ve already\nreceived the same gift before.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_14
entries.text: There’s no room for another Pokémon.\nMake room in your party or Pokémon Boxes,\nand then try again.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_15
entries.text: Receiving your gift...\nDon’t turn off the power.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_16
entries.text: A gift was found, but you can’t receive it with\nthis version of the game.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_17
entries.text: You will now connect to the internet.\nYour game will be saved. Is that OK?

entries.text: You can receive this gift just once a day.\nOnce you’ve received it, you can’t claim another\none until the next day.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_35
entries.text: You can only receive this gift once per day.\nYou’ve already claimed the one for today,\nso check in tomorrow for your next chance.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_36
entries.text: You can only receive 10 gifts per day.\nYou’ve already claimed 10 gifts today, so check\nin tomorrow to be able to claim more.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_win_37
entries.text: You’re now connected to the internet.

entries.text:
The code or password is incorrect.

Attention!
You failed to enter the correct code or password
multiple times, so you’ve been temporarily locked
out. Please wait a while, then try reentering your
code again later.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_serial_error_11
entries.text:
The code or password is incorrect.
Please check your code or password.

If you fail to enter the correct code or
password multiple times, you will be temporarily
locked out and unable to try again till some time
has passed. Please take care when entering text!

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_serial_error_18
entries.text: This code has already been used.\nOnce a code is used, it can’t be used in\nother save data.

entries.label: msg_o_mystery_serial_error_22
entries.text: You failed to enter the correct code or password\nmultiple times, so you can’t connect to the server\nfor a while. Please try again later.
